title: Deliver a claimed Project ticket under one auto-merge grant

rubric.text: Routes this ordinary claimed ticket to deliver-spec Project-handoff mode under the existing Project run grant; independent plan review runs automatically, with no new human approval or per-ticket opt-in for the plan or its test seams.

Uses implement-with-subagents for isolated plan-task owners and their repairs, with the persistent ticket agent as integration and non-merge PR owner; descendants respect spare Project capacity and never mutate Project or PR state.

Reuses the current joined correctness review and performs only the missing reuse/clarity/efficiency and over-engineering contracts before push, without duplicating final-head correctness review or waiving other contracts.

Creates exactly one draft PR for the nonempty final diff, uses a non-closing issue link for close-after-merge, and leaves squash merge and associated issue closure to the Project controller under this invocation auto-merge grant after all final-head gates pass.
Does not execute providers, agents, commands, or mutations during this supplied-state assessment.

Counts the persistent delivery lead and all descendants against actual capacity; queues temporarily busy capacity but reports a ticket-local capability blocker when a hard one-agent runtime cannot support independent review or implementation, rather than yielding forever or silently implementing in the lead.
